name: Talking head with chapters (Ali Abdaal-style)
description: Friendly 16:9 talking head: pauses and fillers trimmed, the topic stated up front, a name lower-third and an end card. Chapter cards, B-roll and sound design are listed as not available yet.
author: dax-editor contributors

beats.name: Topic and promise
beats.guidance: Say the topic and what the viewer will get in the first lines.

beats.name: Chapters
beats.guidance: One idea per chapter, each opening with a title card.
beats.footage: Talking head with B-roll that shows what is said.

beats.name: Recap
beats.guidance: Repeat the main points in one breath.

deferred.title: Purposeful B-roll
deferred.description: Cutaways that illustrate what is being said; none that only fill time.

deferred.title: Chapter cards
deferred.description: Full-screen title cards at each topic change.

deferred.title: Zoom-ins at key moments
deferred.description: Gentle zoom-ins on the points that matter, not every sentence.

deferred.title: Captions
deferred.description: Subtitles added in post for sound-off viewing.

deferred.title: Music and sound design
deferred.description: A music bed and small sound effects.

notes.text: If a company paid you, gave you the product free, or you have any other connection to it, say so clearly in the video, not only in the caption or description.

Use only music you have the right to use: a licensed or CC0 library, or your own. Do not reuse a platform's in-app sound library on other platforms, and check that the licence covers paid ads if you promote the video.
The style name describes a publicly discussed editing pattern. This template is not affiliated with or endorsed by any creator, and it does not copy anyone's footage, graphics or captions.
